Why Choose HydraFacial™?

HydraFacial™ treatments are uniquely effective because they combine cleansing, exfoliation, extraction, hydration, and antioxidant protection all in one appointment. Unlike harsher facials or peels, HydraFacial™ is gentle and non-invasive, offering immediate improvement in skin tone, texture, and brightness. According to the American Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgery, HydraFacial™ has become one of the most requested in-office facial treatments due to its instant glow and zero downtime.

HydraFacial™ Signature

$175.00

Our foundational treatment for radiant skin. The Signature HydraFacial deeply cleanses and exfoliates the skin using HydraFacial’s patented Vortex-Fusion® technology. It also delivers powerful hydrating serums that nourish the skin while removing impurities.

Each treatment is customized by our aesthetician to suit your unique skin type and concerns, from dullness and dryness to uneven tone and texture. Perfect for monthly skin refreshers.

HydraFacial™ Deluxe

$225.00

Elevate your skincare with the Deluxe HydraFacial, which includes everything in the Signature experience—plus a personalized booster serum designed to target your most pressing skin concerns, such as fine lines, discoloration, or congestion.

This treatment also includes LED light therapy to stimulate collagen and soothe inflammation. It’s ideal for patients seeking more targeted treatment and visible rejuvenation.

HydraFacial™ Platinum

$250.00

The ultimate HydraFacial experience. Your Platinum session begins with relaxing lymphatic drainage to reduce facial puffiness and improve circulation, followed by the full Deluxe HydraFacial protocol.

This comprehensive treatment addresses multiple skin concerns at once, providing deeper hydration, increased clarity, and a visibly refreshed appearance. Platinum is our go-to recommendation for patients preparing for major events or those pursuing advanced skin health.

What Skin Concerns Can HydraFacial™ Improve?

HydraFacial™ is effective for treating a wide variety of skin concerns, including:

  • Fine lines and wrinkles
  • Elasticity and firmness
  • Skin tone and vibrancy
  • Uneven texture
  • Brown spots and sun damage
  • Oily or congested skin
  • Enlarged pores

It’s gentle enough for sensitive skin but powerful enough to make a visible impact after a single session.

Frequently Asked Questions About HydraFacial™

How long does the treatment take?

Most sessions last 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the level of treatment you choose.

Is there any downtime?

No. Patients leave with glowing, hydrated skin and can return to regular activities immediately.

How often should I get a HydraFacial™?

Monthly treatments are recommended for optimal skin health and maintenance.

Is HydraFacial™ good for sensitive skin?

Yes, it is safe and effective for most skin types, including sensitive or acne-prone skin.
